usedFor: HeySummit registers event attendees and Sangam CRM follows up on leads, so “New Attendee” can fill the pipeline through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Attendee” in HeySummit, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Each registration becomes a lead, and an attendee who already exists is updated instead of added again.

watchOut: “Create or Update Lead” looks up by ID, email or phone, so map one of those from “New Attendee”.
